versions.subject: Rule: Suspicious executions in web folders / non-exe folders
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image: 
        - 'C:\PerfLogs\*'
        - 'C:\Users\All Users\*'
        - 'C:\Users\Public\*'
        - 'C:\Users\Default\*'
        - 'C:\Windows\addins\*'
        - 'C:\Windows\Fonts\*'            
condition: selection

        - 'C:\Perflogs\*'
        - '*\config\systemprofile\*'
        - '*\Windows\Fonts\*'
